auth_type.correction: api_key (normally sent as an Authorization bearer token)

free_tier_limits.correction: Free plan: 500 requests per month, up to 100 objects per request, 24-hour data sync, and 2 API keys; intended for evaluation, prototyping, and non-commercial or personal use.

rate_limits.correction: Sustained traffic above 20 requests per 10 seconds is rejected with HTTP 429.

cors.correction: Browser requests are blocked by default and allowed only when the request origin hostname is configured on the API key.

description.correction: Read-only JSON country-data API covering names, codes, capitals, currencies, languages, borders, geography, flags, and other fields. The maintained public surface is v5 at api.restcountries.com and requires an API key for normal access; a restricted demo key can be used without an account.

notes: The service is operational, but this entry describes its obsolete open v3.1 API. Official 2026 documentation marks v1-v4 deprecated and directs users to authenticated v5. Pricing, quotas, throttling, and CORS behavior are now explicitly published.
